events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate referral tests and probe, check dashboard wiring and T-057 record
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/ops/ | grep -i -E "referr|outreach"; find . -name "probe-referrals.mjs" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head; grep -n -i "outreach\|replies" workshop-plan/ops/referrals.py | head -30; grep -n -i "replies\|outreach" workshop-plan/referrals.html | head -20; grep -rn -i "T-058\|Bharath.*sign.off\|caps" coord/status/c.md 2>/dev/null | head -8; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run referral tests and inspect the referral probe
events.input: $ python3 -m pytest -q workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py 2>&1 | tail -3; sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-referrals.mjs | cut -c1-220; grep -n -i "replies\|outreach\|goto\|click" app/scripts/probe-referrals.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run referral tests directly and the local synthetic dashboard probe
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py 2>&1 | tail -3; (cd app && node scripts/probe-referrals.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6); grep -n -i "replies\|outreach" app/scripts/probe-referrals.mjs workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py | cut -c1-180 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect test and probe structure to add a Replies check
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py 2>&1 | grep -c PASS; grep -n "^def \|check(\|^if __name__\|fixture" workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py | cut -c1-170 | tail -30; sed -n 295,310p workshop-plan/ops/referrals.py; sed -n 60,84p app/scripts/probe-referrals.mjs | cut -c1-230

events.head: Read the dashboard cell markup
